info.title: Matomo Reporting API for CustomReports plugin

get.summary:
Copies a specified custom report to one or more sites. If a custom report with the same name already exists, the new custom report
will have an automatically adjusted name to make it unique to the assigned site.

parameters.name: idCustomReport
parameters.description: The ID of the custom report to duplicate.

parameters.name: idDestinationSites
parameters.description: Optional array of IDs identifying which site(s) the new custom report is to be assigned to. The default is [idSite] when nothing is provided.

200.description: Response indicating success and containing the ID of the newly created report.

example.message: The custom report has been successfully copied.
The custom report has been successfully copied.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the report.

parameters.name: reportType
parameters.description: The type of report you want to create, for example 'table' or 'evolution'. For a list of available reports call 'CustomReports.getAvailableReportTypes'

parameters.name: metricIds
parameters.description: A list of metric IDs. For a list of available metrics call 'CustomReports.getAvailableMetrics'

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: By default, the report will be put into a custom report category unless a specific categoryId is provided. For a list of available categories call 'CustomReports.getAvailableCategories'.

parameters.name: dimensionIds
parameters.description: A list of dimension IDs.  For a list of available metrics call 'CustomReports.getAvailableDimensions'

parameters.name: subcategoryId
parameters.description: By default, a new reporting page will be created for this report unless you specifiy a specific name or subcategoryID. For a list of available subcategories call 'CustomReports.getAvailableCategories'.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: An optional description for the report, will be shown in the title help icon of the report.

parameters.name: segmentFilter
parameters.description: An optional segment to filter the report data. Needs to be sent urlencoded.

parameters.name: multipleIdSites
parameters.description: An optional list of idsites for which we need to execute the report

get.summary:
Updates an existing custom report. Be aware that if you change metrics, dimensions, the report type or the segment filter,
previously processed/archived reports may become unavailable and would need to be re-processed.

parameters.name: idCustomReport
parameters.description: The ID of the custom report to update.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the report.

parameters.name: reportType
parameters.description: The type of report you want to create, for example 'table' or 'evolution'. For a list of available reports call 'CustomReports.getAvailableReportTypes'

parameters.name: metricIds
parameters.description: A list of metric IDs. For a list of available metrics call 'CustomReports.getAvailableMetrics'

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: By default, the report will be put into a custom report category unless a specific categoryId is provided. For a list of available categories call 'CustomReports.getAvailableCategories'.

parameters.name: dimensionIds
parameters.description: A list of dimension IDs.  For a list of available metrics call 'CustomReports.getAvailableDimensions'

parameters.name: subcategoryId
parameters.description: By default, a new reporting page will be created for this report unless you specifiy a specific name or subcategoryID. For a list of available subcategories call 'CustomReports.getAvailableCategories'.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: An optional description for the report, will be shown in the title help icon of the report.

parameters.name: segmentFilter

parameters.description: List of sub report ids mapped to this report

row.name: Unique Cities
row.description: The unique number of Cities. When viewing a period that is not day, then this metric will become "Sum of Unique Cities". In such case, if the same Cities appear in 2 or more days within the selected period, then it will be counted as 2 or the total number of days it has appeared and not 1.

tags.name: CustomReports
tags.description:
The Custom Reports API lets you 1) create custom reports within Matomo and 2) view the created reports in the Matomo Reporting UI or consume them via the API.

You can choose between different visualizations (eg table or evolution graph) and combine hundreds of dimensions and metrics to get the data you need.
